name: kpi_customers
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.customer_360

name: kpi_orders
sql: SELECT SUM(orders) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.monthly_kpis

name: kpi_gmv
sql: SELECT SUM(gross_revenue) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.revenue_by_channel

name: kpi_aov
sql: SELECT SUM(net_revenue) / SUM(valid_orders) AS value FROM iceberg.gold.revenue_by_channel

name: ltv_distribution
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN net_revenue <= 0 THEN '0. no revenue' WHEN net_revenue < 50 THEN '1. < 50' WHEN net_revenue < 250 THEN '2. 50-250' WHEN net_revenue < 500 THEN '3. 250-500' WHEN net_revenue < 1000 THEN '4. 500-1k' WHEN net_revenue < 2500 THEN '5. 1k-2.5k' WHEN net_revenue < 5000 THEN '6. 2.5k-5k' ELSE '7. 5k+' END AS ltv_bucket, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM iceberg.gold.customer_360 GROUP BY 1

name: churn_risk_mix
sql: SELECT churn_risk, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM iceberg.gold.customer_360 GROUP BY 1

name: rfm_segment_mix
sql: SELECT rfm_segment, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM iceberg.gold.customer_360 GROUP BY 1

name: revenue_trend
sql: SELECT month, SUM(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue, SUM(net_revenue) AS net_revenue FROM iceberg.gold.revenue_by_channel GROUP BY 1

name: channel_mix
sql: SELECT channel, SUM(net_revenue) AS net_revenue FROM iceberg.gold.revenue_by_channel GROUP BY 1

name: category_mix
sql: SELECT category, SUM(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue FROM iceberg.gold.revenue_by_category GROUP BY 1
